Job description
Job ID

There are over 7 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW.

 

 John Deere is an equal opportunity employer, including disabled & veterans.

Primary Location: United States (US) - Illinois  - East Moline  
Function: Technology (CA)
Title: Software Developer - 123849 
Onsite/Remote:Onsite Position

Your Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer for John Deere Harverster Works, located in Moline, IL, you will work as part of an agile product team to develop, test, and support software solutions that help improve manufacturing operations and business processes. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, product owners, and business partners to deliver customer value while building your technical and professional skills.

In this role, you will:

Develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications and services.
Participate in agile team activities such as planning, estimation, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and use feedback to continuously improve your technical skills.
Investigate and resolve software defects and production issues with guidance from experienced team members.
Learn and apply modern software engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability.
Collaborate with teammates and business partners to understand requirements and deliver effective technical solutions.
Contribute to application documentation, technical knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement efforts.
Build knowledge of manufacturing processes, business operations, and the technologies that support them. 

VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position

What Skills You Need
You should have experience in coding and problem-solving skills.  Experience in multiple technologies, and the ability to work independently. The tech stack used includes Experience developing applications using React and TypeScript through academic coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience.
Foundational programming and problem-solving skills.
Basic understanding of web application development, APIs, databases, and software testing concepts.
Familiarity with Git and modern software development practices.
Strong communication, collaboration, and learning agility. 
What Makes You Stand Out
Exposure to Python, SQL, or data engineering concepts through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience.
Familiarity with cloud-native development practices and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms.
Experience using GitHub and modern software development workflows, including pull requests and automated testing.
Exposure to Agile software development methodologies and team-based delivery practices.
Familiarity with application monitoring, observability, or troubleshooting concepts.
Experience with data platforms such as Databricks or analytics-focused solutions.
Knowledge of manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial business processes.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot. 
Education

Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field; or equivalent relevant experience.

What You'll Get

At John Deere, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. Here, you'll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, the support to think outside the box and the advanced tools and technology that foster innovation and achievement. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive reward package to help you get started on your new career path, including:

Flexible work arrangements
Highly competitive base pay 
Savings & Retirement benefits (401K and Defined Contribution)
Healthcare benefits with a generous company contribution in the Health Savings Account
Adoption assistance
Employee Assistance Programs
Tuition assistance
Fitness subsidies and on-site gyms at specific Deere locations
Charitable contribution match
Employee Purchase Plan & numerous discount programs for personal use
Vacation and Holiday Pay

 $74,988.00  - $112,476.00  + Benefits

Follow this link to learn more about our Total Rewards Package https://bit.ly/3XCd8fL 

Must be 18 years of age or older to apply
